title: The engine: the browser's checks speak our words at the box, with no grey bubble
change: In dom.js (reference $SP/w1/judge-forms/A/core/ui/dom.js with every evidence-only OFF branch removed: ON becomes DOC), installed once at import when a real document exists (data-forms-kit on <html>): a capture 'invalid' listener that cancels the bubble, draws validityWords under the box (small.help.field-error[data-kit], aria-invalid, aria-describedby) and, for the first box of the pass, clears the form's old line inside steady(), brings the field under the top bar (reveal start, visualViewport aware, dispatching window 'planner:reveal') and focuses it with preventScroll inside the tap's event; boxes in novalidate forms are left alone. Silent checkValidity (depth counter wrapping HTMLInput/Select/TextArea/Form .checkValidity). Finger-down hold: from pointerdown to that gesture's click (or 400 ms after pointerup, or pointercancel) words are only noted. Leaving words on a capture focusout for boxes holding something unusable (not empty; a box in no form with only a step mismatch says nothing), drawn with steady(the newly focused box). Words go on the next input/change that makes the box valid. ui.fieldError(box, words). base.css form block: .field-error (red, 600), input/select/textarea[aria-invalid=true] red edge, .field boxes scroll-margin-top 40px. title: Boxes the kit reads itself: '1,200', '2.555' and '5%' taken, impossible figures stopped, phone and email keyboards
change: ui.numberBox({name, value, min, max, whole, percent, required, missing}) used by ui.form for type number and percent: a text box with inputmode decimal and data-kind, read by readNumber; a percent box shows '%' inside (.unit-in, .unit) with placeholder 'e.g. 7'. title: Return goes to the next box a person types in; only the last box saves
change: In a kit form, Return in a one-line box (text, number, money, percent, date, tel, email) moves to the next typeable box (one-line or notes) and is stopped there; in the last one the browser's implicit submit runs (and the engine with it). Choice lists and tick boxes are skipped. enterKeyHint 'next'/'done' set at build and again on focusin. A box in no form inside #content: a bubble-phase keydown on document (a page's own Enter runs first, e.defaultPrevented left alone): a value that cannot be used -> reportValidity(); else the next box of the same .form/.card/fieldset; else blur(). Search boxes skipped. Correction to the reference copy: 'cannot be used' is the same test as leaving a box (M5), so a step-only mismatch in a box in no form (Capital gains' Gain at step 1000 holding 1250) moves on instead of reporting.
